newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Tamil rebels overrun army camp, kill 13.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Tamil rebels overrun army camp, kill 13.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels overran an army camp in eastern Sri Lanka on Sunday killing at least 13 soldiers, including a lieutenant, military officials said.
The rebels captured weapons and burned down the Mavadivembu camp in the Batticaloa district, 200 km (125 miles) from Colombo, they said.
Seven soldiers of the army's 6th Gajaba Regiment were wounded while five were missing after the raid, they said.
A large group of Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels attacked the camp shortly after midnight on Saturday and fighting lasted about 45 minutes, the officials added.
The spokesman for the defence ministry's operational headquarters was not immediately available for comment.
The camp was base for about 60 soldiers but one platoon of 30 was out on patrol when the rebels attacked, the officials said.
Army reinforcements managed to reach the camp by dawn, they said.
Casualties among the rebels, who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the mainly Sinhalese Indian Ocean island's north and east, were not immediately known.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the ethnic war, now in its 14th year.
